source.author: 阿哲Phil (@Formulasearch)
source.title: 还在用原始对话框？教你用 Obsidian Canvas 与 Agent 协作
source.extraction_method: public X SSR metadata plus anonymous TweetResultByRestId GraphQL with withArticlePlainText

primary_thesis: Linear chat records what was said but does not reliably encode current project state; for complex work, Chat, Canvas, Markdown/files, tasks and agents should form a shared, persistent workspace.

verified_claims.claim: Sensecape supports nonlinear exploration through canvas and hierarchy views and found that users explored more topics and organized knowledge hierarchically.
verified_claims.limits: UIST 2023 within-subject user study; novelty, learning-curve, clutter and limited exposure are acknowledged by the paper.

verified_claims.claim: CanvasConvo evaluated a branching canvas/chat interface with 24 participants in a five-day field study; canvas sessions averaged 34.1 minutes and chat sessions 13.0 minutes.
verified_claims.limits: The fetched PDF labels itself an unpublished working draft; duration differences are observational telemetry, not proof that canvas causes better outcomes.

verified_claims.claim: Cursor canvases are durable artifacts alongside terminal, browser and source control, and are used for data-heavy nonlinear visualizations such as incident response, PR review, eval analysis and autoresearch.
verified_claims.limits: Vendor-authored product description, not an independent effectiveness study.

verified_claims.claim: JSON Canvas is an open file format whose top level contains nodes and edges; nodes can be text, file, link or group and include explicit position and dimensions.
verified_claims.limits: The format encodes structure and layout but does not itself define project-state authority, permissions, provenance or conflict resolution.

verified_claims.claim: Canvas LLM provides a Canvas-like branching LLM workspace inside Obsidian, but registers the custom .canvas-llm extension rather than using native .canvas as its own workspace format.
verified_claims.limits: Native .canvas appears in the README as a supported file input; release 1.1.7 registers FILE_EXT=canvas-llm and view type canvas-llm-view. The plugin still exposes provider, Vault and web-input surfaces requiring separate review.

verified_claims.claim: Cannoli can use native Obsidian Canvas as a visual workflow DSL, call models, read/write a vault and perform predefined HTTP requests.
verified_claims.limits: This demonstrates execution capability, not production-grade permission isolation, rollback or audit governance.

verified_claims.claim: Obsidian cannot reliably restrict community plugins to narrow permission levels, so plugins inherit Obsidian's access and sensitive-data use warrants independent security review.
verified_claims.limits: This is a host-level risk boundary; it does not establish that either named plugin is malicious or exploitable.

corrections_and_boundaries: A canvas is not automatically the project's source of truth; without a schema and reconciliation protocol it is only a mutable view file.
Moving or deleting a node does not safely update an agent's understanding unless the edit is converted into a typed change intent, validated, applied to canonical state and read back.
Spatial proximity and color are presentation hints, not sufficient machine semantics; important relations and statuses need typed fields or labeled edges.
The article's Chat + Canvas + Markdown + Agent loop is directionally strong, but Tasks, evidence, authority, revision and conflict handling are also required for governed execution.
No Obsidian plugin was installed and no external account, X interaction or runtime side effect was performed.
